events.text: Qingming: families sweep the graves of their ancestors and burn paper offerings.

effects.log: Clean stones, quiet words.
Someone should.

events.text: People wear willow branches to keep away wandering spirits.

effects.log: Nothing wanders near you.
The graveyard fills with whistling.

events.text: You visit the grave of an old master of your art, long dead.

choices.text: Pour tea and tell them your progress

effects.log: The wind moves the grass. Maybe that is an answer.

choices.text: Practise their form at their grave

effects.log: You understand it better here.

events.text: Robbers use the Qingming crowds to rob fresh graves.

ok.log: The robbers are caught. The families thank you.

choices.text: Set a watch with the villagers

effects.log: Nothing is stolen this year.

events.text: Qingming is also for spring outings. Families picnic among new grass.

effects.log: It flies over the graves like a message.
Life and death, side by side, and it is fine.

events.text: At the graveyard you see the grave of someone you once fought.

effects.log: Old enemies are only old now.
Respect, without forgiveness.

events.text: Shops sell paper horses, paper houses, even paper swords, to burn for the dead.

choices.text: Burn a paper sword for a fallen friend

effects.log: May they fight well wherever they are.
Someone deserves a warm house now.

events.text: It always rains at Qingming, the old people say. It is raining.

effects.log: Cold and clean.

choices.text: Share an umbrella with a stranger at a grave

effects.log: You listen to their story.

events.text: Your family takes you to sweep the graves of people you never met.

effects.log: Stories of a great-grandmother who fought bandits with a ladle.
The elders say you are a good child.

events.text: An ancient tomb in the hills, its guardian statues worn smooth.

effects.log: Nobody has swept it in a thousand years. You feel thanked.
A general who died defending a pass that no longer matters. It mattered to him.

events.text: At a grave you find a letter weighed down with a stone, addressed to the dead.

effects.log: Some conversations are private.
A small kindness to a stranger's grief.

events.text: The last paper burns. The families walk home in the drizzle.

effects.log: Thinking of everyone gone.
The dead would want you to live well.
